senses.en: the act of photographing a scene or part of a scene without interruption

senses.en: carry out

take steps

senses.en: require (time or space)

senses.en: take somebody somewhere

examples.en: can you take me to the main entrance?

senses.en: get into one's hands, take physically

Can you take this bag, please

senses.en: take on a certain form, attribute, or aspect

examples.en: His voice took on a sad tone
The story took a new turn
he adopted an air of superiority

examples.en: She assumed strange manners

examples.zh: 众神在这些寓言中 假设人类或动物形态

senses.en: interpret something in a certain way; convey a particular meaning or impression

examples.en: I read this address as a satire

examples.en: How should I take this message?
examples.zh: 我该怎么接受这个消息?

examples.en: You can't take credit for this!

senses.en: take something or somebody with oneself somewhere
senses.zh: 带些东西或一个人 与自己某处

examples.en: Bring me the box from the other room
examples.zh: 把另一间房的盒子拿来

examples.en: Take these letters to the boss
This brings me to the main point

senses.en: take into one's possession
senses.zh: 将自己藏起来

examples.en: We are taking an orphan from Romania
examples.zh: 我们从罗马尼亚带走一个孤儿

examples.en: I'll take three salmon steaks

senses.en: travel or go by means of a certain kind of transportation, or a certain route

examples.en: He takes the bus to work

examples.en: Take any one of these cards
Choose a good husband for your daughter
She selected a pair of shoes from among the dozen the salesgirl had shown her
examples.zh: 她从这十几只卖家女中 选了一双鞋子

senses.en: receive willingly something given or offered
senses.zh: 自愿接受给予或提供的东西

examples.en: The only girl who would have him was the miller's daughter
examples.zh: 唯一愿意拥有他的女孩是磨坊主的女儿

examples.en: I won't have this dog in my house!
examples.zh: 我家里不会有这只狗的!

examples.en: Please accept my present

senses.en: assume, as of positions or roles

examples.en: She took the job as director of development
examples.zh: 她接了发展总监的工作

examples.en: he occupies the position of manager
the young prince will soon occupy the throne
examples.zh: 年轻的王子很快就会登上王位

senses.en: take into consideration for exemplifying purposes
senses.zh: 为举例说明目的考虑

examples.en: Take the case of China

examples.en: It takes nerve to do what she did
success usually requires hard work
examples.zh: 成功通常需要辛勤工作

examples.en: This job asks a lot of patience and skill
examples.zh: 这份工作需要很多耐心和技巧

examples.en: This position demands a lot of personal sacrifice
examples.zh: 这个职位需要很多个人牺牲

examples.en: This dinner calls for a spectacular dessert
examples.zh: 这顿晚饭需要一个壮观的甜点

examples.en: This intervention does not postulate a patient's consent

senses.en: experience or feel or submit to
senses.zh: 经历或感受或服从

examples.en: Take a test
Take the plunge

senses.en: make a film or photograph of something
senses.zh: 拍一部电影或某样东西的照片

examples.en: take a scene
shoot a movie

senses.en: remove something concrete, as by lifting, pushing, or taking off, or remove something abstract

examples.en: remove a threat
remove a wrapper
Remove the dirty dishes from the table
take the gun from your pocket
This machine withdraws heat from the environment
examples.zh: 这台机器能从环境中吸收热量

senses.en: serve oneself to, or consume regularly
senses.zh: 为自己服务或经常消费

examples.en: Have another bowl of chicken soup!
I don't take sugar in my coffee
examples.zh: 我不把糖在我的咖啡中

senses.en: accept or undergo, often unwillingly
senses.zh: 接受或接受,往往不愿意接受或接受

examples.en: We took a pay cut

senses.en: make use of or accept for some purpose
senses.zh: 利用或接受某种目的;

examples.en: take a risk
take an opportunity

senses.en: take by force
senses.zh: 使用武力

examples.en: Hitler took the Baltic Republics
examples.zh: 希特勒占领了波罗的海各共和国

examples.en: The army took the fort on the hill
examples.zh: 军队占领了山上的堡垒

senses.en: occupy or take on
senses.zh: 占领或接管

examples.en: He assumes the lotus position
She took her seat on the stage
examples.zh: 她就坐在舞台上,我看见她了

examples.en: We took our seats in the orchestra
She took up her position behind the tree
strike a pose

senses.en: admit into a group or community
senses.zh: 进入一个群体或社区

examples.en: accept students for graduate study
We'll have to vote on whether or not to admit a new member
examples.zh: 我们只能投票决定是否接纳新成员

senses.en: ascertain or determine by measuring, computing or take a reading from a dial
senses.zh: 通过测量、计算或从拨号上读取读数来确定或确定

examples.en: take a pulse
A reading was taken of the earth's tremors

senses.en: be a student of a certain subject
senses.zh: 成为某个学科的学生

examples.en: She is reading for the bar exam

senses.en: take as an undesirable consequence of some event or state of affairs
senses.zh: 将某些事件或事态视为不良后果

examples.en: the accident claimed three lives

examples.zh: 辛勤工作让她付出了代价

senses.en: head into a specified direction
senses.zh: 向指定的方向前进
senses.labelZh: 前进；朝某方向走去；行进

examples.en: The escaped convict took to the hills
examples.zh: 越狱的犯人被带往山上

examples.en: We made for the mountains

senses.en: point or cause to go (blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment) towards
senses.zh: 指向或导致(吹气、武器或摄影设备等物体)

examples.en: Please don't aim at your little brother!
He trained his gun on the burglar
Don't train your camera on the women
examples.zh: 别在女人身上训练相机

examples.en: Take a swipe at one's opponent

senses.en: be seized or affected in a specified way
senses.zh: 以特定方式扣押或影响

examples.en: take sick
be taken drunk

senses.en: have with oneself; have on one's person
senses.zh: 与自己在一起; 与一个人在一起;

examples.en: She always takes an umbrella
I always carry money
She packs a gun when she goes into the mountains

senses.en: engage for service under a term of contract
senses.zh: 根据合同条款聘用服务

examples.en: We took an apartment on a quiet street
examples.zh: 我们在一条安静的街道上住过公寓

examples.en: Let's rent a car
Shall we take a guide in Rome?
examples.zh: 我们在罗马找个向导好吗?

senses.en: receive or obtain regularly
senses.zh: 定期接收或获取

examples.en: We take the Times every day
examples.zh: 我们每天都要看《时代周刊》

senses.en: buy, select
senses.zh: 购买, 选择

examples.en: I'll take a pound of that sausage

senses.en: to get into a position of having, e.g., safety, comfort
senses.zh: 进入安全、舒适等地位

examples.en: take shelter from the storm

senses.en: have sex with; archaic use
senses.zh: 与性行为; 过时使用

examples.en: He had taken this woman when she was most vulnerable
examples.zh: 他抓走了这个女人当她最脆弱的时候

senses.en: lay claim to; as of an idea
senses.zh: (a) 向;作为设想

examples.en: She took credit for the whole idea

senses.en: be designed to hold or take
senses.zh: 用于持有或带走

examples.en: This surface will not take the dye

senses.en: be capable of holding or containing
senses.zh: 能够持有或含有

examples.en: This box won't take all the items
examples.zh: 这个盒子不会拿走所有的东西的

examples.en: The flask holds one gallon

senses.en: develop a habit
senses.zh: 发展习惯

examples.en: He took to visiting bars

senses.en: proceed along in a vehicle
senses.zh: 乘车继续前进

examples.en: We drive the turnpike to work

senses.en: obtain by winning
senses.zh: 以赢法获得

examples.en: Winner takes all
He took first prize

senses.en: be stricken by an illness, fall victim to an illness
senses.zh: 受疾病之苦,成为疾病的受害者

examples.en: He got AIDS
examples.zh: 他得了艾滋,他得了艾滋,你觉得呢?

examples.en: She came down with pneumonia
She took a chill
